title: Reconstruct retries and delegated agents as observed rollout branches
narrative: Nubble needs the observed run topology — retries, spawned reviewers, and terminals — as a first-class graph linked back to the intended plan, not only the planned node list. Accepts FineEnvs training-sequence reconstruction[^fineenvs-rollout].
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/roots_and_retry.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
